verdicts.reason: A: the purple circle has come loose from the can and sits alone at the bottom with nothing around it. The quote text is small and pressed against the left edge, the attribution is jammed right under the quote, and the space below the can is empty, so it reads as a shrunk copy. B keeps the can layered over its circle as in the original and sets the quote larger and easier to read. Its flaws: the oversized quote mark competes with the headline, there is a big empty gap between the mark and the quote, and the can sits almost on the bottom edge.
